hero.title: Rendered in Go. Interactive in React.
hero.lead: Gopage compiles templates into one binary and sends HTML first. JavaScript ships only for the components you mark, in React or a few lines of TypeScript. No Node at build or run time.

source.title: one file per component, one per route

missing.title: no route answers this address
missing.lead: the router walked the manifest and found nothing for this path.

failure.title: the page could not be rendered
failure.lead: a loader or the render itself returned an error. the log line names the route.
